# Sentence Labs

> An applied research lab building infrastructure for real-time, structured interaction.

Sentence Labs Private Limited is an applied research lab. We design and build
infrastructure for real-time, structured interaction — the systems layer that
lets products exchange structured state live, reliably, and at scale.
